preset.rule: The pages are dense technical exposition with equations, tables, captions, and experimental results, which matches a reference-style scientific document more than a textbook or storybook.

renderStrategy.rule: The book combines dense text with many positioned figures, tables, and multi-column layouts where preserving page appearance is useful while still needing accessible text reconstruction.

pageGrouping.rule: The sampled pages read as standard pages with page-local figures, tables, and captions rather than compositions that depend on facing-page continuity across the gutter.

sectioningMode.rule: Each sampled page functions as a self-contained unit of scientific text or a page-bound figure/table segment, so keeping pages whole is the most natural division.

activitiesGenerator.rule: The book is a research article-style document with exposition, equations, tables, and figures, and there is no evidence of exercises or interactive activities.

figureExtraction.rule: The pages contain many figures, diagrams, plots, and composite scientific visuals where some should likely be extracted as standalone figures, but not necessarily every candidate.
